fields.description: Yas Riva Reserve is Aldar's gated collection of 292 four- to six-bedroom villas beside the water northeast of Yas Island. Inland and waterfront homes form separate groups, with gardens and a community clubhouse connecting the neighbourhood. It is a distinct release from the original Yas Riva development.

reviewCoverage.identity: 292-villa Reserve release confirmed independently of original Yas Riva's 151 homes.

reviewCoverage.residences: Official four/six-bedroom range and inland/waterfront mix checked against phase-specific documents.
reviewCoverage.areas: Presentation's own GSA/plot table visually reviewed; figures are configuration averages, not individual plan guarantees.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Official page and launch release reviewed; no automatic pontoon entitlement inferred.

reviewCoverage.payment: Presentation's nine-stage table visually checked and percentages total 100.

reviewCoverage.documents: Own Reserve presentation, factsheet and seven-page plans located; four-bedroom drawing visually reviewed. Original Yas Riva brochure rejected. Duplicate presentation copy not allocated a second word budget.

overview: The landscape links the villas with walking routes, recreation space and the residents' club. Indoor exercise, study areas and children's facilities complement outdoor pools and courts. These are planned community amenities; access conditions and delivery dates should be checked against the chosen home.
research.locationNote: Aldar places the community northeast of Yas Island, directly opposite Yas Riva, with a new bridge planned to connect it to the island. This wording is retained instead of assigning an unverified neighbourhood pin.
research.priceNote: The current official page starts at AED 7.9m. Aldar's 18 September 2026 announcement instead quoted AED 8.5m at launch. The fact sheet lists inland five/six-bedroom references of AED 9.3m/10.5m and waterfront five/six-bedroom references of AED 13.3m/14.5m. Confirm today's available villa and final quotation.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed presentation schedules 5% at booking, five further 5% instalments, two 10% instalments and 50% at handover. These advertised terms require confirmation in the buyer's contract.
research.handoverNote: Impala reports Q3 2030. The reviewed Aldar landing page does not publish a completion quarter, so this remains a broker-reported estimate requiring developer confirmation.

facts.label: Release composition
facts.value: 247 inland and 45 waterfront villas. These describe the development, not currently unsold stock.

facts.label: Published service-charge references
facts.value: The presentation quotes AED 6.21 per sq ft for 2030 and AED 6.33 for 2031. Confirm the chargeable area, approvals and the advertised five-year waiver's eligibility and exclusions.

facts.label: Advertised incentives
facts.value: The official page advertises a five-year service-charge waiver and 2% ADM fee waiver. Applicability, expiry and exclusions need written confirmation.

facts.label: Waterfront flexibility
facts.value: The launch release describes the option to incorporate a pontoon. It does not establish that every waterfront purchase includes an installed pontoon or unrestricted mooring rights.

facts.label: Layout example
facts.value: The four-bedroom inland drawing has ground and first floors, with separate family and formal living areas downstairs. Confirm the chosen layout and whether the illustrated pool is included.
